| String arrow(int day)
  instruction
    | String name;
  case
    | day
    | 1
    | 2, 3
    | default
    -
      instruction
        | name = "Monday";
    -
      instruction
        | name = "Midweek";
    -
      instruction
        | name = "Other";
  jump
    | return name

== Modern.expression (line 12)
| int expression(int day)
  instruction
    | int len;
  case
    | day
    | 1
    | 2
    | default
    -
      instruction
        | len = 6;
    -
      call
        | work();
      instruction
        | len = 7;
    -
      instruction
        | len = 0;
  jump
    | return len
